description: Review the whole change before it ships: checks the branch diff against the spec (every requirement R1… delivered, nothing out of scope), the project's recorded conventions and off-limits areas, and the code itself (correctness, security, error handling, tests, performance). Writes a ranked review.md with file:line evidence and blocks spec-ship on blockers. Use after spec-verify, when the user says "review this", "code review", "review the branch", "review PR #42", "is this ready to merge", or "/spec-review". Also works with no spec folder, on any branch, diff, or pull request, including a teammate's. Reports findings and offers fixes; it changes code only after the user says yes, through spec-implement's fix loop. Also handles the reviewers' comments once the PR is open ("address the PR comments", "the PR got review feedback", "changes requested on PR #42"): triages them, then runs the changes back through implement → verify → review → checkpoint → ship on the same PR.
